test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

The issue has been successfully resolved by the customer care team.

options.text: The customer care team successfully resolves the issue.
The customer care team successfully resolved the issue.
The issue has successfully resolved the customer care team.
The customer care team has successfully resolved the issue.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The customer care team has successfully resolved the issue."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the issue" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "has resolved" to "has been resolved" (present perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the customer care team."
 
• Ensure the sentence structure is correct and clear.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The customer care team has successfully resolved the issue."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The customer care team successfully resolves the issue." – Incorrect tense (present simple).
 
• **Option 2: **"The customer care team successfully resolved the issue." – Incorrect tense (simple past).
 
• **Option 3: **"The issue has successfully resolved the customer care team." – Incorrect structure (subject and object are reversed).

```
